definitions.explanation: Used to introduce an explanation or reason for something stated before.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{来|こ}なかった。なぜなら{病気|びょうき}だったからだ。
examples.english: He didn't come. The reason is that he was sick.

examples.japanese: なぜなら、{私|わたし}には{時間|じかん}がないからです。
{成功|せいこう}した。なぜなら{努力|どりょく}を{続|つづ}けたからだ。
examples.english: I succeeded, because I kept making an effort.

notes:
USAGE:
なぜなら typically starts a new sentence or clause and is followed by the reason, often ending with からだ/からです.

PATTERN:
[Statement]. なぜなら〜からだ/からです。

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
・なぜなら (because, the reason is - formal/written)
・だって (because - casual)
・というのは (the reason is - explanatory)
・というのも (the reason being - explanatory)

NOTE:
なぜなら is more common in written Japanese and formal speech. In casual conversation, だって or simply 〜から is more common.
